detail: split: PGRightJaw hole PGRightJaw_H8_0 off its (u,v) by 0.046; PGRightJaw hole PGRightJaw_H16_0 off its (u,v) by 0.092; PGRightJaw hole PGRightJaw_H24_0 off its (u,v) by 0.137
known: Root cause found, not fixed (0.05-0.14 mm, proportional to the hole's u). After split, the renamed end P10s has no previous-pose entry, so solveBodyJointTopology places it along the stored seed direction (the 16 mm split offset) while the lattice holes are placed along the previous pose's direction; distance checks cannot see a 0.33 degree rotation (the second-order change is below the 1e-3 tolerance). Fixing it needs either carrying the previous pose over to the renamed id in splitNode (the app and test hold the previous points outside node-editor) or changing the solver's seeding order, which this pack must not do. Harmless to the student: the pose is under-constrained and redrawn each frame.
